summary.text: Christian Phelps is a Democratic member of the Wisconsin State Assembly who has represented District 93 since January 2025 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026, general election.
A former communications director and journalist from Eau Claire, he serves on the Education Committee.

paragraphs.text: Christian Phelps was born in Eau Claire, Wisconsin, and graduated from Eau Claire Memorial High School.
He earned a bachelor's degree from Vassar College in 2016 and a graduate degree from Cardiff University in 2020.
His career experience includes working as a communications director, journalist and education professional.

In a 2024 Ballotpedia survey, Phelps said he worked as a special education paraprofessional in Madison and was a member of Madison Teachers Inc., then earned a master's degree in journalism at Cardiff University and returned to Eau Claire in 2020.

He said he served as director of digital organizing and communications for the Wisconsin Public Education Network, on the steering committee of Support Eau Claire Public Schools, and on the board of the Eau Claire Public Schools Foundation.
Phelps took office on January 6, 2025, succeeding Republican Warren Petryk in District 93, and serves on the Education and Public Benefit Reform committees.
In the 2024 survey he described himself as "the pro-public candidate," citing public education, public health, public land and public participation in democracy.
